# Glam'more Unisex Salon — Official Site

Unisex salon in Thukalassery, Thiruvalla, Kerala, India.
Haircuts, hair colouring, keratin and smoothening, bridal makeup, facials, massage, nail art, threading, and waxing for men and women.

## Base URL
https://glammoresalon.in

## About
Glam'more is a unisex salon serving men and women in Thiruvalla. Clients come for everyday services (haircuts, beard trims, threading) and for weddings and events (bridal makeup, saree draping, pre-bridal facials). The salon is on SH 1 (Kollam–Theni Highway) at Thukalassery and is easy to reach from Thiruvalla town, Changanassery, Chengannur, and Pathanamthitta.

## Services Offered
### Hair
- Haircuts (men & women)
- Hair colouring (global colour, highlights, grey coverage)
- Keratin treatment
- Hair smoothening
- Hairstyling for weddings and events
- Human hair extensions

### Bridal & Makeup
- Kerala bridal makeup (HD and airbrush)
- Bridal hairstyling and saree draping
- Wedding party and family makeup
- Party and event makeup

### Facials & Skin Care
- Facials by skin type
- De-tan and clean-up
- Pre-bridal skin care

### Spa & Massage
- Body massage
- Head and shoulder massage

### Nails
- Acrylic nail extensions and nail art
- Gel manicure
- Spa pedicure

### Brows, Lashes & Men's Grooming
- Eyebrow threading
- Eyelash extensions
- Shaving and beard styling

### Waxing
- Body waxing
- Facial waxing
